blurb: Moon Curser Vineyards is located in Osoyoos, Okanagan Valley, British Columbia, Canada. They produce a wide variety of wines including Syrah, Tannat, Tempranillo, Touriga Nacional, Carménère, Nebbiolo, and others. Their portfolio focuses on original and less common varietals rather than popular ones like Pinot Gris or Chardonnay.
